snapshot_source: Hand-curated enumeration of kloppy SkillCorner provider fields consumed by ingestion.skillcorner._dataset_to_rows as of 2026-04-20. SkillCorner Open Data, kloppy OpenSource provider.
notes: source_to_bronze: every kloppy-exposed field the bronze parser captures, mapped to its bronze col name.
excluded_source_fields: kloppy-exposed fields intentionally NOT captured in bronze (yet); each entry has a reason.
When kloppy upgrades its SkillCorner provider or new fields surface, update this fixture + either the bronze parser (add the col) or the excluded map (with a reason).
Source-attribute names are purpose-descriptive (not dotted paths) since kloppy's accessor shape differs per field (some on Frame, some on Player, some on Point).

excluded_source_fields.player_name: kloppy Player.name — display name; planned for bronze expansion in a follow-up PR after PR 1.5 ships.
excluded_source_fields.player_first_name: kloppy Player.first_name — redundant with Player.name once captured; not useful standalone.
excluded_source_fields.player_last_name: kloppy Player.last_name — redundant with Player.name once captured; not useful standalone.
excluded_source_fields.player_jersey_no: kloppy Player.jersey_no — currently consumed only to derive is_goalkeeper (fallback heuristic). Planned for bronze expansion in a follow-up PR.
excluded_source_fields.player_current_position: kloppy Player.position (vs starting_position) — tracks in-match position changes. Planned for bronze expansion.
excluded_source_fields.player_positions_list: kloppy Player.positions — list of positions over the match. Planned for bronze expansion alongside current_position.
excluded_source_fields.team_name: kloppy Team.name — planned for bronze expansion; home_team_id / away_team_id already capture identity.
excluded_source_fields.frame_other_data: kloppy FrameData.other_data — provider-specific supplementary dict; low-value for analysis, omitted by design.
excluded_source_fields.frame_statistics: kloppy FrameData.statistics — derived per-frame stats; reconstructable from tracking, omitted by design.
